<!-- Written by tools/website.py from the tutorial 'Lysozyme in Water'. Do not edit: run the script again instead. -->

Some programs stop and ask a question, such as which group of atoms to use. The lines between `<<'COMFYGMX_STDIN'` and `COMFYGMX_STDIN` are the answers, given in advance. Typing a command by hand, you can leave them out and answer the questions yourself.

**① Run parameters (.mdp)**

It writes the run-parameter file `nvt.mdp`, which later blocks read:

??? abstract "nvt.mdp"

    ```ini
    ; Lysozyme tutorial, verbatim: 100 ps restrained NVT at 298 K, CHARMM36 force-switched LJ, velocities generated. — edited here, not the stock lysozyme_nvt
    ; generated by Comfy-gmx

    ; ---- Run control -------------------------------------
    title      = Lysozyme NVT equilibration
    integrator = md
    dt         = 0.002
    nsteps     = 2500

    ; ---- Output control ----------------------------------
    nstxout   = 2500
    nstvout   = 2500
    nstlog    = 2500
    nstenergy = 50

    ; ---- Neighbour searching -----------------------------
    cutoff-scheme = Verlet
    nstlist       = 10
    ns-type       = grid
    pbc           = xyz

    ; ---- Electrostatics ----------------------------------
    coulombtype    = PME
    rcoulomb       = 1.2
    fourierspacing = 0.16
    pme-order      = 4

    ; ---- Van der Waals -----------------------------------
    vdw-modifier = force-switch
    rvdw         = 1.2
    rvdw-switch  = 1.0
    dispcorr     = No

    ; ---- Temperature coupling ----------------------------
    tcoupl  = V-rescale
    tc-grps = System
    tau-t   = 0.1
    ref-t   = 298

    ; ---- Pressure coupling -------------------------------
    pcoupl = no

    ; ---- Velocity generation -----------------------------
    gen-vel  = yes
    gen-temp = 298
    gen-seed = -1

    ; ---- Bonds -------------------------------------------
    constraints          = h-bonds
    constraint-algorithm = lincs
    continuation         = no
    lincs-order          = 4
    lincs-iter           = 1

    ; ---- Restraints / pulling ----------------------------
    define = -DPOSRES
    ```

**② Preprocess (grompp)**

```bash
# gmx grompp
gmx grompp -f nvt.mdp -c em.gro -p topol.top -o nvt.tpr -po mdout.mdp -r em.gro
```

**③ Run MD (mdrun)**

```bash
# gmx mdrun
gmx mdrun -s nvt.tpr -deffnm nvt -v
```

**④ Energy terms**

```bash
# gmx energy
gmx energy -f nvt.edr -o temperature.xvg <<'COMFYGMX_STDIN'
Temperature
COMFYGMX_STDIN
```

**⑤ Preview plot**

Draws its file inside the block. It runs no program.
